fields.name: Local authority
fields.description: Local authority responsible for the library service

fields.name: Local authority code
fields.description: Official Government Statistical Service (GSS/ONS) 9-character code for the local authority

fields.name: Library name
fields.description: Full public name by which the library branch or service point is known

fields.name: Library code
fields.description: Identifier or code used locally or nationally for the library branch

fields.description: Address line 1

fields.name: Postcode
fields.description: Postcode for the library building

fields.name: Unique property reference number
fields.description: Unique property reference number for the building unit the library is located in

fields.name: Latitude
fields.description: Latitude coordinate in WGS84 decimal degrees

fields.name: Longitude
fields.description: Longitude coordinate in WGS84 decimal degrees

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Current operating status of the library

fields.name: Statutory
fields.description: Whether the library is part of the statutory public library service

fields.name: Facility type
fields.description: The physical facility type of the service point

fields.name: Type of library
fields.description: The operating model of the public library branch

fields.name: Year opened
fields.description: Year the library opened

fields.name: Year closed
fields.description: Year the library permanently closed

fields.description: Unstaffed opening hours for Monday

fields.description: Changes to normal opening hours such as for public holidays

fields.name: Weekly staffed hours
fields.description: Total number of staffed hours per regular week

fields.name: Weekly total hours
fields.description: Total number of open hours (staffed plus unstaffed) per regular week

fields.name: Automated access system
fields.description: Automated access control or self-service system used to support visitors during unstaffed opening hours (e.g. Open+, Lyngsoe, Self-service kiosk)

fields.name: Co-located
fields.description: Whether the library is co-located with other services or organizations in the same building unit

fields.name: Co-located with
fields.description: Details of services or facilities co-located with the library. For multiple co-locations, separate values with a semicolon (;), e.g. 'Council customer services; Community centre; Post office'.

fields.name: Guest wifi
fields.description: Whether free public Wi-Fi is available to any visitor without requiring library membership

fields.name: Member wifi
fields.description: Whether Wi-Fi is available to registered library members using library card authentication

fields.name: Public computers
fields.description: Whether the library provides public access computers for visitors

fields.name: Printing
fields.description: Whether printing, copying, or scanning facilities are available for public use

fields.name: Meeting rooms
fields.description: Whether meeting rooms, study rooms, or hireable event spaces are available for public or community use

fields.name: Quiet study space
fields.description: Whether dedicated quiet study areas, study carrels, or desk spaces with power outlets are provided

fields.name: Step-free access
fields.description: Whether the library entrance and main service areas have step-free / level access for wheelchair users and pushchairs

fields.name: Accessible toilet
fields.description: Whether an accessible wheelchair-friendly public toilet or Changing Places facility is available on site

fields.name: Hearing loop
fields.description: Whether an induction loop or hearing loop system is installed to support hearing aid users

fields.name: Facilities and services
fields.description: Semicolon-separated list of all public facilities, amenities, and specialized digital resources available at the library branch (e.g. 'Books; Printing; Free Wi-Fi; Findmypast; British Newspaper Archive; BFI Replay; Meeting rooms')

fields.name: Phone number
fields.description: Direct public phone number for this specific library branch

fields.name: Email address
fields.description: Direct public email address for this library branch, or the general service email if not available

fields.name: URL
fields.description: Public web page URL specifically for this library branch

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Public notes regarding library services, facilities, or planned changes
